bms_g_4168_200005b8.name: bms_seed_key_work_words
bms_g_4168_200005b8.description: Two 16-bit working words of bms_seed_key_transform, written on every call. Word 0 (0x200005b8) is a 16-bit checksum-style value (probably a CRC) of the 16-byte input block, and word 1 (0x200005ba) is that value XORed with the byte sum of the same block. The transform uses the same values to pick S-box rows and rotation amounts. They are derived working values, not key bytes, and nothing in this packet reads them back (probably kept for debugging).
